description:
Use this when you need a broad 2026-2028 date offset and accept OpenWorkdays reference semantics, including its source observed/estimated flags. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the task requires a direct official authority, regional/local or employer calendar, or dates outside published coverage.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts working days using the pinned OpenWorkdays national-scope reference for 246 country/territory codes.
Example user requests: Add five broad-reference working days to 2026-10-23 in Australia.
Inputs: start_date (date); territory (enum); working_days (integer, working days).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-10-23","territory":"AU","working_days":5}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added [working days], calendar_days_elapsed [days], non_working_weekend_days_skipped [days], public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, source_territory_name, weekend_days, working_weekend_day, holiday_names, holiday_observed, holiday_estimated, holiday_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, substitute_day_policy, source_quality, dataset_version, coverage_start, coverage_end, source_url.
Formula: move one Gregorian day at a time; decrement remaining only when the source reference status is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/global-reference-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/global-reference-add-working-days.md

territory.description: ISO-style alpha-2 country code supported by the pinned OpenWorkdays reference snapshot.

working_days.description: Signed offset; the start date is excluded for non-zero offsets. Unit: working days.

name: add_global_reference_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: National reference plus country weekend and explicit working-weekend dates.

holiday_estimated.description: True when an included event is marked estimated by the source.

holiday_names.description: Included national-scope public-holiday names on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when an included event is marked observed by the source.

holiday_policy.description: National-scope events with source observed/estimated flags preserved.

non_working_weekend_days_skipped.description: Regular weekend dates crossed. Unit: days.

source_quality.description: Open derived reference, not a direct national authority feed.

source_territory_name.description: Raw country name from the hash-pinned OpenWorkdays source catalogue.

substitute_day_policy.description: Source flags are preserved; no new substitute-day rule is inferred.

territory_name.description: Calcgrid display name; TW is displayed as 中国台湾省 while the machine code remains TW.

weekend_days.description: Weekend convention supplied by the source country file.

working_days_added.description: Signed requested offset. Unit: working days.

working_weekend_day.description: True when the source explicitly marks a weekend date as an official working day.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Global Reference Working Days
